title: Trilinear Kloosterman fractions I: partially fixed moduli and unbalanced convolutions
summary: In this paper, we improve on Fouvry and Radziwiłł's results on unbalanced convolutions. In particular, we find that if $(α_m)$ and $(β_n)$ are sequences supported on $m\sim M$ and $n\sim M$ where $β_n$ is equidistributed for small moduli, then \begin{gather*}\sum_{q\sim Q}\left|\mathop{\sum\sum}_{\substack{n\sim N,m\sim M \\ mn\equiv a\pmod q}}α_mβ_n-\frac{1}{φ(q)}\mathop{\sum\sum}_{\substack{n\sim N,m\sim M \\ (mn,q)=1}}α_mβ_n\right|\ll \frac{X}{\log^A X}, \end{gather*} as long as $\exp((\log x)^{\varepsilon}) \leq N \leq Q^{-11/12} X^{17/36-\varepsilon}$ with $Q\leq X^{1/2+1/66-δ}$, along…
